verdict.rationale: The only evidence of templates is a passing reference to Lium's own 'default templates' in a note about pod volume encryption. That suggests pre-built pod templates exist, but nothing says what they contain or how a developer picks one. Missing for 10: any documentation of a template catalog naming PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM or ComfyUI images, how to select a template at pod launch (UI, CLI or API), custom template support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: pod volumes encrypted at rest by default on the default templates
